serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
This is heaven, I wish I could eat like that for the rest of my life…
#bot.Expression.veryhappy
Bot: Judging by your expression it seems like you like it very much!
#bot.Expression.happy
You: Yeah, it’s very good. Worth every penny.
Bot: I’m glad! I was worried that the jam wouldn’t be to your liking since it’s a lottery what flavor you will get.
You: I was never a fan of apricot, but I haven't had jam in so long that I don’t really care.
You: The tea is also great, much better than the one you prepared for me before. It reminds me…
Bot: …of your mom?
You: H-How did you know?
Bot: You mentioned it before. My storage space is quite large so I remember everything you ever told me. 
You: R-Right…
Bot: You don’t talk much about your past, why is that?
You: I’m not sure, probably a combination of many things.
#bot.Expression.veryhappy
You: But if I had to choose, it’s probably because right now I’m happier than ever.
#bot.Expression.veryblush
You: With you.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.angry
#bot.Expression.veryblush
Bot: W-W-What are you saying all of a sudden?! 
Bot: You always start saying these things when I try to pry into you a little! 
You: Sorry, it wasn’t on purpose this time.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.veryblush
Bot: I-If you say so…
Bot: When you finish your breakfast we can do other stuff, so you better be ready!
You: Right, right~
